import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and group revenue by month and region, ensuring one value per group.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = (df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue']
             .sum())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, data in grouped.groupby('region'):
    data = data.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(data['month'], data['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
